headline: On October 15, 1991: Oh-My-God particle observed in Utah
captionCards: Challenged theories on cosmic ray origins and propagation
instagramCaption:
The Fly's Eye camera detected an ultra-high-energy cosmic ray. \\[The Oh-My-God particle, observed on October 15, 1991, at the University of Utah HiRes observatory, had an energy of (3.2±0.9)×10²⁰ eV, making it 40,000,000 times more energetic than the highest energy protons produced in a particle accelerator. This unexpected discovery challenged existing theories about the origin and propagation of cosmic rays. As of 2026, it remains the highest-energy cosmic ray ever observed. \\Why do you think this discovery was so surprising? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
